keys modes fixture

One set of bindings pressed in every mode. T and ? are bare: T, then ?, in raw mode; g T and g ? in leader mode; Alt+T and Alt+? in activator mode. g c, Control+K, and Escape are as written in every mode. Each button's aria-keyshortcuts follows the mode and the reader's settings. Add ?mode=leader or ?mode=activator to the URL to set the page's mode.
